node.title: Sub-square-root interleaving collapse
node.statement: For every F-linear code, agreement threshold, and base worst-list size 1<=L<q=|F|, the m-fold common-support interleaved worst list satisfies L<=L_m<=floor(L(q-1)/(q-L)); hence L_m=L for every m>=1 whenever L^2<q. [2026-07-12 import: independently brute-forced from the statement alone — 1,132 theorem checks + 215 collapse-equality checks, 0 violations; the common-support hypothesis is LOAD-BEARING (separate-support mutation fires); honest limitation: no growth instance exists in the tested grid, so the rational bound's constant is untested (the collapse equality is the tested content). Strictly improves survey Lemma 2.10 [GGR11] in the sub-sqrt regime. audit_bruteforce_20260712.py banked.]
